document.abstract: Welcome to this special issue of the SMPTE journal on Internet Protocol (IP) systems and their integration. Guest Editor Brad Gilmer has gathered a number of excellent papers to expand our view on the current state of IP systems implementations across the industry in this first of two SMPTE journal issues.
